1.0.6.notes:
- Added a static search experience on Home with fast local filtering.
- Added scroll-aware animations and rollable hub sections to the Orbit feed.
- Refreshed navigation with monochrome icons and a stationary bottom bar that tucks away during active scrolling.
- Polished theme, spacing, and motion across the app shell.
- New-chat creation, account deletion, and reset-email delivery still require the next Cloud Functions deployment.
- End-to-end encryption is not implemented in this build.
